listing.name: RuFlo AI Team
listing.tagline: Give Claude a team that plans, works, and verifies results
listing.description: RuFlo AI Team helps Claude organize complex work across specialized AI agents. Start with a goal or reusable playbook, review the proposed roles and budget, and create a tenant-isolated workspace for tasks, approved context, progress, and evidence. Use it for research, release preparation, security reviews, implementation planning, and other multi-step work. OAuth isolates every tenant, RuVector accelerates tenant-local retrieval, and stored agent content is treated as untrusted data. Version 0.1 coordinates work but does not silently publish, send messages, deploy software, purchase items, or execute arbitrary commands.

security_controls: Every tool declares a title and all four annotation hints as explicit booleans.
No tool accepts a tenant identifier, token, password, API key, private key, or credential.
All tenant tool calls require OAuth and are issuer-, audience-, expiry-, tenant-, and scope-checked.
Foreign and missing object identifiers return the same not_found response.
RuVector indexes are separated by verified tenant and team and held in a bounded cache.
Stored agent, task, memory, and evidence content is provenance-labelled and nonce-fenced as untrusted data.
The initial connector has no external-write, arbitrary-command, deployment, purchasing, credential, public-sharing, or deletion tool.

examples.prompt: Create a three-role team to research the market and verify the conclusions.
Show the tasks and evidence for this run.
Remember this approved release constraint and find it later.
